about_the_game:
Fleetbreakers Early (Alpha) Build

Liberate the galaxy from the evil Voltari Empire in this action strategy, sci-fi roguelike where fast-paced action combat meets deep, strategic squadron management. Fleetbreakers flips the strategy genre into something new by blending quick and rewarding gameplay with the depth and replayability that strategy games are known for.

This free demo build contains the Prelude and Act 1 of the full version of Fleetbreakers, releasing in Early Access later this year. No two playthroughs will be exactly the same; play it as many times as you would like.

Develop, Deploy, & Destroy

  • Build your fleet of squadrons from a diverse set of ships, each with their own abilities advantages, and upgrades

  • Use your Mothership to construct powerful stations and activate special support abilities

  • Easily control, command, and deploy your squadrons to explore the map or engage the enemy

Choose Your Strategy

  • Campaign overmap gives you control of each run, generating unique encounters with their own challenges and rewards

  • Make decisions to out maneuver the enemy and turn the tide of battle as the campaign unfolds before your eyes

If You Don’t Succeed.. Fight Again

  • Freedom isn’t free. Grow your strength by completing missions, collecting rewards, and rejoining the fight against the Voltari.

  • Missions are fast-paced and highly replayable: giving players the opportunity to try new tactics and approaches to every new challenge

  • Progression systems with robust procedural maps ensure that each encounter is different. There is always something new to discover in space

Full Controller Support

  • Unlike most action strategy titles, Fleetbreakers is fully playable with both a controller or a mouse and keyboard

short_description: Fleetbreakers is a modern blend of classic strategy and fast-paced combat. Build your fleet, upgrade your units, and manage your squadron as you battle through a unique roguelike campaign in the quest to liberate space from the evil Voltari.
